image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a white and blue steam iron resting on a dark surface. The iron features a glossy white plastic body with blue accents, a metallic soleplate visible at the bottom, and a handle structure at the top. A power cord connector is visible at the rear. The background is a blurred dark blue/grey wall.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The top part of the handle features a strange gold/bronze metallic texture that looks inconsistent with the rest of the plastic body. It appears slightly 'melted' or fused into the white plastic, lacking a clear mechanical seam or attachment point.

The circular port at the back looks somewhat soft and ill-defined, lacking the sharp geometric precision expected of a manufactured plastic mold. It blends slightly into the surrounding white plastic.
The edge where the white body meets the metal soleplate has slight waviness and inconsistency in thickness, suggesting minor generation artifacts in the boundary definition.
